title: Gear selector operation and engagement
summary: Feedback centers on learning and usability of the gear selector, with some praise for the new design but complaints about difficult operation and gear engagement smoothness.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the new gear selector design.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes the gear rocker switch as hard to operate and reports unsmooth gear engagement.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback mentions adjustment time, different selector direction, separate park-button preference, and several ambiguous selector-operation comments without a clear overall valence.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, which limits confidence about overall sentiment patterns.
Several fragments are very brief or ambiguous, including one incomplete excerpt, so some specific user concerns cannot be fully interpreted.
The topic mixes selector layout, operating direction, park-button placement, and transmission engagement smoothness, which are related but not fully identical subjects.
